A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable 39-page versions of Learning to Discretize Denoising Diffusion ODEs. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A-F can be matched reliably, with only localized differences.

before.justification: v3 reports original LD3 sampling experiments, quantitative comparisons, and ablations in Section 5, with additional image-generation, point-cloud, and molecular-docking results in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains the original LD3 experiments and appendix results, including quantitative performance comparisons and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same objective, time-step parameterization, decoupling component, and optimization procedure. The revised ImageNet teacher schedule concerns an experimental configuration, not the proposed LD3 algorithm.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage is unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, including image generation, text-to-image generation, ImageNet-64, ShapeNet point-cloud generation, and molecular docking.

E2.justification: The same heuristic schedules, DMN, GITS, AYS, GGDM+PRED+TIME, and distillation/flow comparators remain in their corresponding comparisons. No comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Appendix D.1.2 changes the reported Uni_PC schedule for generating ImageNet training/validation data from Time uniform to Time quadratic, retaining 10 NFE. LSUN-Bedroom retains Time uniform at 20 NFE. This revises a stated experimental setting without establishing that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The component ablations, solver-transfer tests, data-size analysis, bound sensitivity, training-progress analysis, prompt-set robustness experiment, and qualitative case studies are unchanged, including their appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Tables 14 and 17 retain the same uncertainty reporting. Table 17 still reports averages over five runs, with unchanged values. No run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or statistical tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 4 changes the ImageNet-256 teacher FID from 4.32 to 4.17; all LD3 and other reported results remain unchanged. Because the documented teacher schedule also changes, this is a revised reference result rather than evidence of a same-setting performance gain. The correction note in Table 22 already appears in v3.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, Theorem 1, assumptions, and proof in Appendix A.1 are unchanged. No derivation or formal guarantee is added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about efficient learned discretization, solver applicability, and sampling quality. Their highlighted LD3 performance figures are unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including the explanations of soft teacher forcing and solver specificity, the quality gap relative to distillation, and the requirements for differentiable solvers and separate training for each NFE.

D1.justification: Appendix D.1.2 revises the reproduction instructions for ImageNet teacher-data generation to specify Time quadratic instead of Time uniform. Other implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, and code/access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and substantive positioning relative to earlier research are unchanged. Changes to citation text color do not introduce new references or alter attribution.

P1.justification: One training-data sentence in Appendix D.1.2 is revised, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The title, section organization, and remaining narrative are unchanged.

P2.justification: Several existing citations change from black to blue, and the revised appendix sentence wraps differently. Figures, table structures, captions, and overall page organization remain unchanged; the Table 4 numerical update is assessed under E6.

improvement.justification: The paired updates to the ImageNet teacher specification in Appendix D.1.2 and its reference FID in Table 4 provide a limited refinement of experimental documentation, alongside more consistent citation formatting. The benefit concerns reproduction and interpretation of the teacher setup; the PDFs establish no new LD3 performance gain or broader scientific advance.
